question: To what height should the upper part of the pedestal be raised relative to the Vishnu portion?
premises: The upper part of the pedestal is to be raised.
The Vishnu portion provides a reference boundary.
The limit is half of that boundary.
inference: The upper part of the pedestal should be raised up to half the boundary of the Vishnu portion.
plain_english: One should raise the upper part of the pedestal up to half the limit of the Vishnu portion.
